drug_name: SEL PH BABY PH-BALANCED ECZEMA DRYNESS BABY
what_its_for: This product is a gentle, pH-balanced moisturizing cleanser and skin care product made especially for babies with eczema-prone or very dry skin. It helps soothe, cleanse, and moisturize delicate baby skin while maintaining the skin's natural protective barrier. It is not a prescription medicine — it is a topical skin care product designed to reduce dryness, itching, and irritation commonly seen with eczema in infants and young children.
how_to_take: Use this product on your baby's skin as directed on the packaging. Apply a small, gentle amount to the affected dry or eczema-prone areas of the skin. If it is a wash or cleanser, lather gently during bath time, rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water, and pat skin dry softly — do not rub. If it is a lotion or cream, apply a thin layer directly to clean, slightly damp skin after bathing. Avoid getting the product in your baby's eyes, mouth, or nose. Do not apply to broken, infected, or open skin unless your baby's doctor tells you it is safe to do so.
dosing: Use as often as directed on the product label, or as recommended by your baby's doctor or pharmacist. For most moisturizers, applying 1 to 2 times daily — especially right after bath time — works best to lock in moisture. There is no strict dose since this is a topical skin care product, but use only the amount needed to cover the affected area with a thin, even layer. Do not over-apply.
missed_dose: If you forget to apply the product at your usual time, apply it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for the next scheduled application, just skip the missed application and continue with your regular routine. Do not apply extra amounts to make up for a missed application.
storage: Store this product at room temperature, away from direct sunlight and heat. Keep the cap or lid tightly closed when not in use. Do not freeze this product. Keep it out of reach of children to prevent accidental ingestion. Check the expiration date on the package and do not use the product after it has expired.
what_to_avoid: Avoid using other harsh soaps, perfumed products, or alcohol-based skin products on the same areas of your baby's skin, as these can worsen dryness and irritation. Avoid hot bath water — use lukewarm water instead. Do not use this product near your baby's eyes. Avoid exposing your baby's skin to known irritants such as rough fabrics, wool, or heavily scented laundry detergents. Do not use this product if your baby has an active skin infection without first talking to your baby's doctor.
when_to_call_doctor: Call your baby's doctor right away if: the skin becomes more red, swollen, or irritated after using this product; your baby develops a rash, hives, or signs of an allergic reaction such as swelling of the face or difficulty breathing; the eczema does not improve after a few weeks of regular use; the skin looks infected (oozing, crusting, or very warm to the touch); or you are unsure whether this product is right for your baby's skin condition.
when_it_works: You may begin to notice softer, less dry skin within a few days of regular use. For eczema-prone skin, it may take 1 to 2 weeks of consistent daily use to see a meaningful improvement in dryness and irritation. This product works best when used as part of a daily skin care routine, especially after baths. It does not cure eczema but helps manage and relieve symptoms when used regularly.
special_populations: This product is specifically formulated for babies and young children with sensitive, eczema-prone, or very dry skin. Always consult your baby's pediatrician or dermatologist before starting any new skin care product, especially if your baby is a newborn, was born prematurely, or has a known skin condition or allergies. This product is intended for external use on babies only and should not be used by adults unless directed by a healthcare provider.
